metadata.title: The Fake DNA Test & The Blood-Oath Will
metadata.subtitle: She faked a paternity DNA test and bribed a shaman to hex me—then the dead patriarch’s voice exposed her live in the vault.

nodes.text: 9:47 PM · Eve of the late Chairman’s will reading. Bianca—Sebastian’s childhood friend—drops a bombshell in the family trust group.
I’m twelve weeks pregnant with Sebastian’s heir! Since the Chairman’s will requires a biological grandchild to inherit, Audrey should pack tonight.
Twelve weeks? Sebastian was in Zurich for a heart-valve summit twelve weeks ago, Bianca. Check your calendar.
Bianca, stop! We had ONE business dinner in Geneva and I passed out in the lounge—there’s no way!
Mrs. Audrey, stay calm. Your late father-in-law installed an acoustic failsafe inside the underground will vault.

nodes.prompt: Bianca smirks and claims she already has a certified prenatal DNA test:

options.label: Demand to see the clinic stamp
options.player_reply_text: Post the full lab sheet with the barcoded sample ID right now, Bianca. Let Evelyn verify it.

options.label: Ask why she burned a charm outside
options.player_reply_text: Security saw you burying a black-wax charm pouch under my rosebush an hour ago. Trying to hex me before the vault opens?

nodes.text: Gladly! And by the way—if your chest feels tight tonight, maybe you just can’t handle losing.
You’re hallucinating! Wait—why is my own nose suddenly bleeding onto the DNA folder?!
9:54 PM · The grandfather clock in the estate library tolls once—even though its weights were removed the day the Chairman died.

nodes.headline: Blood on the Lab Sheet
nodes.teaser_text: Next: Bianca uploads the DNA report—and Evelyn spots a fatal flaw.

nodes.text: 10:06 PM · Bianca snaps a photo of the laminated paternity report on the dining table and drops it into the chat.

nodes.caption: 99.99% match! Read it and weep, Audrey. Tomorrow the vault transfers 51% to my baby.

nodes.text: Interesting. The lab barcode lists "Mercy Diagnostics — Branch 4". That branch shut down for malpractice eight months ago.
It’s a clerical typo on the header!! The sample was processed at their main lab! Sebastian, are you really letting her call your child a fraud?!

nodes.prompt: Sebastian looks torn between the report and Evelyn’s warning:

options.label: Challenge Bianca to take the Blood-Oath
options.player_reply_text: Fine. Step into the Chairman’s vault at midnight and swear on his blood-oath ledger. If you’re telling the truth, you have nothing to fear.

options.label: Ask Evelyn about the shaman’s payment
options.player_reply_text: Evelyn, check if Bianca wired money from her corporate expense card to a "V. K. Occult Consultancy" this morning.

nodes.text: Deal! I’ll stand in that vault at midnight and watch you lose everything!
Found a $9,500 wire at 8:14 AM labeled "Spiritual Consultation" AND a $15,000 transfer to an ex-lab tech from Branch 4!
Wait... Bianca, why did my grandfather’s portrait in the hallway just fall flat on the carpet—right at your feet?!

nodes.headline: The Fallen Portrait
nodes.teaser_text: Next: Behind the fallen frame lies a sealed note written in the Chairman’s own hand.

nodes.text: 10:28 PM · Rain hammers the manor roof. You lift the cracked portrait frame and pull out a cream envelope taped to the wooden backing.
Listen to what your father wrote, Sebastian: "Never trust a child claimed in haste; the vault remembers every voice."
He wrote that years ago when he was senile! Why are my teeth chattering—did someone turn the basement AC to freezing?!
The estate thermostat is off, Miss Bianca. And the underground vault door just chimed "READY FOR EARLY READING".

nodes.prompt: Evelyn asks if you want to descend to the vault now before midnight:

options.label: Lead everyone straight into the vault
options.player_reply_text: Let’s go down right now. Bring your precious DNA sheet, Bianca—let’s see how it holds up under the Chairman’s seal.

options.label: Dig up the black-wax charm first
options.player_reply_text: Wait two minutes. I’m bringing the black-wax charm pouch Bianca buried under my roses—straight into the vault with us.

nodes.text: I’m coming too. Tonight we end this once and for all.
Don’t touch that pouch!! The shaman said if the target breaks the wax seal, the hex rebounds tenfold onto the caster!!
10:42 PM · The heavy steel vault door swings open to reveal an oak table, a brass recorder—and an empty leather chair still warm to the touch.

nodes.headline: The Warm Leather Chair
nodes.teaser_text: Next: The steel vault door slams shut from the outside—locking all four of you inside.

nodes.text: 10:50 PM · BOOM. The biometric vault bolt shoots shut by itself. Red LEDs above the door flash: "OATH VERIFICATION ACTIVE".
Open the door!! Why isn’t my thumbprint working—wait, why is the ink on my DNA report turning black and dripping off the paper?!
Look at the laminated sheet! The 99.99% line just dissolved like wet soot—leaving a blank hospital form underneath!
Thermal ink forgery—triggered by the vault’s UV sterilization lamp. Clever trap by the late Chairman.

nodes.prompt: The brass intercom on the oak table crackles to life with a familiar baritone:

options.label: Listen to the Chairman’s recording
options.player_reply_text: Nobody move. That’s Father’s voice.

options.label: Confront Bianca about Geneva
options.player_reply_text: You weren’t even on Sebastian’s floor in Geneva, were you, Bianca? Who was the man who actually checked into your suite?

nodes.transcript: [deep, resonant voice over intercom] "If Bianca Vale stands in this vault claiming an heir, check the March security log from Geneva Hotel."

nodes.text: Shut up!! How could a dead man know what happened in Geneva?! Turn that intercom OFF!!
My father died four months ago—BEFORE my March trip to Geneva! How is his voice naming Geneva over an offline intercom?!

nodes.headline: A Voice Beyond the Grave
nodes.teaser_text: Next: Bianca’s phone rings inside the concrete vault—where zero cell signal exists.

nodes.text: 11:08 PM · Six feet of reinforced steel surround the vault. Every phone reads "NO SERVICE"—yet Bianca’s screen lights up with an incoming call.
Wait—that’s not the lab tech’s voice! It’s the Chairman coughing!! He’s reading out my real ultrasound date!!
Put it on speaker, Bianca. Let Sebastian hear how many weeks along you really are—or if you’re even pregnant at all.
I’m not even pregnant! I bought a fake ultrasound scan and paid the shaman to keep Audrey sick until the will cleared!

nodes.prompt: Sebastian snatches Bianca’s phone before the unsent notice fades:

options.label: Let Sebastian read the shaman chat
options.player_reply_text: Scroll up two messages, Sebastian. Look at the photo of the wax charm she buried under my window.

options.label: Crack the wax charm on the oak table
options.player_reply_text: Watch closely, Bianca. I’m snapping your black-wax charm in half right now.

nodes.text: There’s no baby... you faked a pregnancy, bribed a closed clinic, and tried to hex my wife?!
AAAH!! My knees just gave out—I feel like a block of ice is crushing my chest!! Make it stop!!
11:16 PM · The vault’s brass safe clicks open on its own, sliding out the genuine red-ribboned will.

nodes.headline: The Red-Ribboned Will
nodes.teaser_text: Next: Evelyn reads the hidden codicil that shocks even Sebastian.

nodes.text: 11:24 PM · Evelyn breaks the crimson wax on the genuine will while Bianca shivers uncontrollably on the marble floor.
Clause 7B: "Should any outsider attempt to defraud the family line with a false heir, 100% of voting shares bypass my son and vest directly in Audrey."
Father trusted Audrey more than me... because he knew I was too blind to see through Bianca!
Wait—someone else put me up to the fake DNA test!! I didn’t think of Branch 4 on my own!

nodes.prompt: Bianca clutches her freezing chest, desperate to trade a name for mercy:

options.label: Demand the mastermind’s name
options.player_reply_text: Speak clearly into Evelyn’s recorder, Bianca. Who bankrolled the clinic bribe and the shaman?

options.label: Ask for the signed payout contract
options.player_reply_text: You wouldn’t risk prison on a verbal promise, Bianca. Where is the side agreement Marcus signed?

nodes.text: Sebastian’s cousin Marcus! He promised to pay off my father’s factory debts if I broke up your marriage before the board vote!
It’s saved in my encrypted notes app! Unlock code 0419—take it, just open this freezing vault!!
11:34 PM · The moment Bianca utters Marcus’s name, the red vault LEDs switch to green and the steel bolt slides back.

nodes.headline: The Green Light
nodes.teaser_text: Next: Evelyn pulls the encrypted payout agreement—and exposes Cousin Marcus live.

nodes.text: 11:52 PM · Upstairs in the study, Evelyn prints the decrypted side agreement from Bianca’s cloud drive and photographs the signature block.

nodes.caption: Confirmed, Mrs. Audrey. Marcus pledged $3M to Bianca upon your ouster. Police are already en route to his penthouse.

nodes.text: Marcus smiled in my face at Father’s funeral while plotting to tear our house apart!
He counted on you doubting me the second Bianca waved a fake paper. And for ten minutes tonight, you almost did.

nodes.prompt: Police cars pull up the gravel drive outside the manor:

options.label: Hand Bianca over to detectives
options.player_reply_text: Escort her to the front porch, Evelyn. Let the detectives take both the fake DNA sheet and the black-wax pouch.

options.label: Call an emergency 8 AM board vote
options.player_reply_text: Evelyn, notify every director that I’m invoking Clause 7B at 8:00 AM sharp. Marcus’s proxy seats are frozen tonight.

nodes.text: I’m sorry, Audrey... I thought the Chairman was just an old myth.
Emergency notice dispatched, Chairwoman. Every independent director has already replied in support.

nodes.headline: Arrest at Midnight
nodes.teaser_text: Next: Cousin Marcus tries to flee the city—only to run straight into the Chairman’s final trap.

nodes.text: 12:40 AM · Highway Patrol flags down Marcus’s black sedan at the north tollgate. Inside the trunk: two offshore passports and $400,000 in cash.
Marcus is in custody, Audrey. He already tried to blame Bianca for everything—until detectives played the vault recording.
Good. Make sure the shaman and the ex-lab tech from Branch 4 are named in the same indictment.
I’m sitting by the library fireplace, Audrey. I keep thinking about how fast I failed you when Bianca showed that fake sheet.

nodes.prompt: Sebastian asks where your marriage stands after tonight:

options.label: Set strict boundaries going forward
options.player_reply_text: No more secret "childhood friend" dinners, Sebastian. And from tomorrow, I run the group—you report to the board.

options.label: Keep the trust strictly in my name
options.player_reply_text: Father left Clause 7B to me for a reason. I’m keeping 100% voting control so nobody ever threatens this family again.

nodes.text: Fair. I’ll sign whatever governance charter you put in front of me, Audrey.
The corporate registry has already logged the voting-share transfer under Clause 7B, Chairwoman.

nodes.headline: The Eve of the Vote
nodes.teaser_text: Next: At dawn, you return to the vault one last time to seal the blood-oath ledger.

nodes.text: 5:50 AM · First pale light touches the estate windows. You descend to the quiet vault with Evelyn to seal the Chairman’s brass recorder.
I checked the intercom wiring out of curiosity, Audrey. The tape reel inside was completely blank—and the power cable was unplugged.
Then he really did come back one last time to keep his promise.

nodes.prompt: You place a fresh white chrysanthemum beside the leather chair:

options.label: Promise to guard his life’s work
options.player_reply_text: Rest in peace, Father. The group is in steady hands now.

options.label: Lock the blood-oath ledger away forever
options.player_reply_text: No more curses or traps in this house. From today, we lead with truth and clean ledgers.

nodes.text: The brass safe door closes with a soft, warm click. The vault air feels completely gentle and still.
Sunlight spills down the stone staircase as you step back up into the morning.

nodes.headline: Morning in the Boardroom
nodes.teaser_text: Finale: At 10:20 AM, the unanimous vote crowns the rightful Chairwoman.

nodes.text: 10:20 AM · Tall glass windows flood the 40th-floor boardroom with morning sun. Twelve directors raise their hands in unanimous confirmation.
Official minutes recorded: Audrey is sworn in as Chairwoman. Criminal indictments against Bianca and Marcus are formally filed.
Congratulations, Chairwoman. I’ll be right outside with your favorite black coffee whenever you finish the press brief.

nodes.prompt: You adjust the gavel on the sunlit oak podium:

options.label: Open the floor for a new era
options.player_reply_text: Thank you, everyone. Let’s build a company worthy of the Chairman’s name.

options.label: Announce a scholarship in Father’s honor
options.player_reply_text: My first act as Chairwoman is redirecting Marcus’s forfeited shares into a medical ethics scholarship.

nodes.text: Warm applause echoes across the bright boardroom as the city skyline sparkles outside.
Evelyn smiles warmly as cameras flash—truth and legacy finally standing hand in hand.

nodes.headline: The Blood-Oath Kept
nodes.teaser_text: You finished "The Fake DNA Test & The Blood-Oath Will"! Explore more karma thrillers.
